title: Kenyan Energizing Porridge
description: A traditional Kenyan breakfast dish made with energizing ingredients to start your day. This porridge is a perfect way to get a boost of energy and nutrients.

ingredients.name: energizing oats
ingredients.notes: Rolled oats infused with energizing herbs

ingredients.name: kenyan honey
ingredients.notes: Raw honey harvested from Kenyan bees

ingredients.name: buttermilk
ingredients.notes: Low-fat buttermilk adds creaminess and tanginess

ingredients.name: coconut oil
ingredients.notes: Unrefined coconut oil adds a hint of flavor

instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the energizing oats and buttermilk.
Add the kenyan honey and coconut oil, and whisk until well combined.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the oats have absorbed most of the liquid and the mixture has a creamy consistency.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with a sprinkle of energizing herbs if desired.
